id.description: The id the viewer is found by: a word of lower-case letters, digits and `_`, 1 to 32.

title.description: Its name for people, as the Open with menu says it.

help.description: A line saying what it shows.

mime_types.description: The MIME types it shows: exact (`application/json`) or by family (`image/*`).

extensions.description: The extensions, without the dot, it shows whatever the type says.

priority.description: Which of two viewers that can show a file is tried first: the higher. The application's own viewers are at -10 to 10.

x-enum-labels.surface: A JSON array of A2UI messages ([`FileViewer::render`] answers it as text), which the application draws with its own widgets in the person's theme.
x-enum-labels.page: One self-contained HTML document with its styles, scripts and pictures inline. The host puts a policy on it that allows no request, form or frame, and the application opens it in the person's browser, since it embeds no web view.

opens_sections.description: Whether it opens a document at a section ([`ViewRequest::section`]).

name.description: The file's name, without its folder.

mime.description: The type the host judged the file to be, when it could.

size.description: The file's whole size in bytes.

truncated.description: Whether `data` stops short of the file.

data.description: What the host read of the file, in base64: its start, as many bytes as one answer of the host carries.

section.description: The heading to open at, by its anchor or its title, for a viewer that [`ViewerInfo::opens_sections`].
